_comment: Floors for the free retrieval gate (python -m eval.retrieval_gate). Baseline 2026-11-18, ReplyHub knowledge base, hybrid mode (production), 26 questions: top1_accuracy 1.0, hit_rate 1.0, mrr 1.0, fact_recall 1.0. Retrieval is deterministic, so each floor allows about one question of slack. Raise a floor when a change improves it.
